decisions.choice: disbelieved: refused to believe
decisions.reason: The verb is the opposite of believe. Unbelief runs through this ending (16:13, 16:14, 16:16).

decisions.choice: he is alive: present tense, the words of the report
decisions.reason: Greek keeps the tense of the message: he lives.

decisions.choice: would not believe (B); did not believe (R)
decisions.reason: The single English word is stiff. Balanced and Readable use the verb believe with a negative.

decisions.choice: no lo quisieron creer (B); no le creyeron (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: the verb means refusing to believe (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: ameonwa naye (L), with no reader setting
decisions.reason: "Naye" here is "by her", Mary, so it takes no deity_pronoun setting; the pronoun for Jesus is inside the verb "ameonwa". Balanced and Readable name Mary to keep it clear.

source.text: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα δυσὶν ἐξ αὐτῶν περιπατοῦσιν ἐφανερώθη ἐν ἑτέρᾳ μορφῇ πορευομένοις εἰς ἀγρόν·

records.literal_gloss: After now these things to two of them walking he appeared in another form, going into [the] country;

en.L: And after these things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared in another form to two of them as they were walking, going into the country;
en.B: After that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to two of them in a different form, as they were walking along on their way into the country.
en.R: Later, Jesus appeared to two of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers while they were walking out into the country. He looked different from before.

vi.L: Sau những việc đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra dưới một hình dạng khác cho hai người trong số họ đang đi đường, lúc đi về miền quê;
vi.B: Sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra dưới một hình dạng khác cho hai người trong số họ, khi họ đang trên đường về miền quê.
vi.R: Sau đó, Đức Giê-xu hiện ra cho hai người trong số những người theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, khi họ đang đi về miền quê. Ngài trông khác với trước.

ko.L: 그 뒤에 그들 가운데 두 사람이 시골로 걸어가고 있을 때, 그분이 다른 모습으로 나타나셨다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 그들 가운데 두 사람이 시골로 걸어가고 있을 때, 예수께서 다른 모습으로 그들에게 나타나셨다.
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 예수를 따르던 사람들 가운데 두 사람이 시골로 걸어가고 있었다. 그때 예수께서 그들에게 나타나셨다. 예수의 모습은 전과 달랐다.

es.L: Después de estas cosas, se apareció en otra forma a dos de ellos que iban de camino, yendo al campo.
es.B: Después se apareció con otro aspecto a dos de ellos, mientras iban caminando hacia el campo.
es.R: Más tarde, Jesús se apareció a dos de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos que iban caminando hacia el campo. Tenía un aspecto diferente al de antes.

fr.L: Après cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se manifesta sous une autre forme à deux d’entre eux qui marchaient, alors qu’ils allaient à la campagne ;
fr.B: Après cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se manifesta sous un autre aspect à deux d’entre eux qui étaient en chemin pour aller à la campagne.
fr.R: Plus tard, Jésus est apparu à deux de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples pendant qu’ils marchaient vers la campagne. Il avait un aspect différent d’avant.

sw.L: Na baada ya mambo haya, aliwatokea wawili kati yao kwa sura nyingine, walipokuwa wakitembea, wakienda shambani;
sw.B: Baada ya hayo aliwatokea wawili kati yao kwa sura tofauti, walipokuwa njiani wakienda mashambani.
sw.R: Baadaye Yesu aliwatokea wafuasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wawili walipokuwa wakitembea kwenda mashambani. Alionekana tofauti na hapo awali.

pt.L: E depois disso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu em outra forma a dois deles, enquanto caminhavam, indo para o campo;
pt.B: Depois disso, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu em outra forma a dois deles, enquanto andavam a caminho do campo.
pt.R: Mais tarde, Jesus apareceu a dois dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores enquanto eles iam andando para o campo. Ele estava diferente de antes.

am.L: ከዚህም በኋላ ከእነርሱ ለሁለቱ ወደ ገጠር ሲሄዱ በመንገድ ላይ በሌላ መልክ ተገለጠላቸው፤
am.B: ከዚህ በኋላ ከእነርሱ ሁለቱ ወደ ገጠር በእግር ሲጓዙ በሌላ መልክ ተገለጠላቸው።
am.R: ከዚያ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ለሁለቱ ወደ ገጠር ሲሄዱ ተገለጠላቸው። መልኩም ከበፊቱ የተለየ ነበር።

decisions.choice: two of them walking into the country: the story told in Luke 24:13-35
decisions.reason: Luke tells how the risen Jesus walked with two disciples on the road to Emmaus.

decisions.choice: in another form: in a form they did not at first recognize
alternatives: in a body other than his own
decisions.reason: In Luke 24:16 their eyes were kept from recognizing him. The phrase does not say what changed.

decisions.choice: the country: the open land outside the city
decisions.reason: They were leaving Jerusalem for the countryside.

decisions.choice: He looked different from before
decisions.reason: Readable puts the phrase in a sentence of its own and names Jesus and his followers.

decisions.choice: en otra forma (L); con otro aspecto (B); tenía un aspecto diferente (R)
decisions.reason: A form they did not at first recognize (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the word; Balanced and Readable say how he looked, and Readable puts it in its own sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: se manifesta (L, B); apparut (16:9)
decisions.reason: Mark's ending uses two verbs, "appeared" in 16:9 and "was made manifest" here and in 16:14; Literal and Balanced keep them apart with "apparaître" and "se manifester", the French used for the second verb in John 21:14. Readable uses the plainer "apparaître".

decisions.choice: wafuasi (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "two of them", those who had been with Jesus (16:10), not "disciples". Readable names them "wafuasi" (followers), as the English Readable does, and keeps "wanafunzi" for the Greek word for disciples (16:7). The same in 16:13 and 16:20.

source.text: κἀκεῖνοι ἀπελθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς λοιποῖς· οὐδὲ ἐκείνοις ἐπίστευσαν.

records.literal_gloss: And they having gone away told [it] to the rest; not even them did they believe.

en.L: And they went away and told [it] to the rest; they did not believe them either.
en.B: These two went back and told the others, but they did not believe them either.
en.R: These two went back and told the other followers. But the others did not believe them either.

vi.L: Và những người ấy đi về báo cho những người còn lại; họ cũng không tin hai người ấy.
vi.B: Hai người này trở về báo cho những người khác, nhưng họ cũng không tin hai người.
vi.R: Hai người này trở về kể lại cho những người khác. Nhưng những người kia cũng không tin họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 돌아가서 나머지 사람들에게 알렸으나, 그들은 이 사람들의 말도 믿지 않았다.
ko.B: 이 두 사람이 돌아가서 다른 사람들에게 알렸지만, 그들은 이 두 사람의 말도 믿지 않았다.
ko.R: 두 사람은 돌아가서 다른 사람들에게 이 일을 알렸다. 그러나 다른 사람들은 두 사람의 말도 믿지 않았다.

es.L: Y ellos fueron y [lo] anunciaron a los demás; tampoco a ellos les creyeron.
es.B: Estos dos volvieron y se lo contaron a los demás, pero tampoco a ellos les creyeron.
es.R: Estos dos regresaron y se lo contaron a los otros discípulos. Pero los otros tampoco les creyeron.

fr.L: Et ceux-là s’en allèrent l’annoncer aux autres ; mais ils ne crurent pas ceux-là non plus.
fr.B: Ces deux-là retournèrent l’annoncer aux autres, mais les autres ne les crurent pas non plus.
fr.R: Ces deux disciples sont retournés le dire aux autres. Mais les autres ne les ont pas crus non plus.

sw.L: Nao walienda, wakawapasha habari wale wengine; wala hawakuwaamini wao pia.
sw.B: Hao wawili walirudi, wakawaambia wale wengine, lakini nao hawakuwaamini.
sw.R: Hao wawili walirudi, wakawaambia wafuasi wengine. Lakini wale wengine hawakuwaamini wao pia.

pt.L: E eles foram e anunciaram [isso] aos demais; nem a eles creram.
pt.B: Esses dois voltaram e contaram aos outros, mas também não acreditaram neles.
pt.R: Esses dois voltaram e contaram aos outros seguidores. Mas os outros também não acreditaram neles.

am.L: እነርሱም ሄደው ለሌሎቹ ነገሩ፤ እነርሱንም ደግሞ አላመኑአቸውም።
am.B: እነዚህ ሁለቱ ተመልሰው ለሌሎቹ ነገሩ፤ እነርሱን ግን ደግሞ አላመኑአቸውም።
am.R: እነዚህ ሁለቱ ተመልሰው ለሌሎቹ ደቀ መዛሙርት ነገሩ። ሌሎቹ ግን እነርሱንም አላመኑአቸውም።

decisions.choice: they did not believe them either: the rest did not believe the two, as they had not believed Mary
alternatives: the two did not believe the rest
decisions.reason: The subject changes. The rest are the ones who did not believe, as in 16:11.

decisions.choice: unbelief: set beside Luke 24:33-35
decisions.reason: In Luke 24:34 the eleven greet the two with the news that the Lord has appeared to Simon. This ending tells it differently and stresses the disciples' unbelief.

decisions.choice: These two; the other followers; the others
decisions.reason: Readable names who is who, since "they" refers first to the two and then to the rest.

decisions.choice: Estos dos (B, R); los otros discípulos (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced and Readable say who went and who did not believe them (meaning decision m1).

source.text: Ὕστερον δὲ ἀνακειμένοις αὐτοῖς τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐφανερώθη, καὶ ὠνείδισεν τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν καὶ σκληροκαρδίαν ὅτι τοῖς θεασαμένοις αὐτὸν ἐγηγερμένον οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν.

records.literal_gloss: Later now reclining they the eleven he appeared, and rebuked the unbelief of them and hardness of heart because those having seen him having been raised not they believed.

en.L: And later {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to the eleven themselves as they were reclining [at table], and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rebuked their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who had seen {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} after {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had been raised.
en.B: Later {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to the eleven themselves as they were eating. He rebuked them for their unbelief and their stubborn hearts, because they had not believed those who had seen {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} risen.
en.R: Later Jesus appeared to the eleven apostles while they were eating a meal. He scolded them because they did not believe and their hearts were stubborn. They had not believed the people who saw {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} alive again.

vi.L: Sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra cho chính mười một [môn đồ] khi họ đang ngồi [ăn], và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách sự vô tín và lòng cứng cỏi của họ, vì họ đã không tin những người đã thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sau khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được làm cho sống lại.
vi.B: Sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra cho chính mười một môn đồ khi họ đang ăn. Ngài quở trách họ vì họ không tin và lòng họ cứng cỏi, vì họ đã không tin những người đã thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại.
vi.R: Sau đó, Đức Giê-xu hiện ra cho mười một sứ đồ khi họ đang ăn. Ngài trách họ vì họ không tin và lòng họ cứng cỏi. Họ đã không tin những người đã thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại.

ko.L: 그 뒤에 열한 [제자]가 [식탁에] 기대어 앉아 있을 때에 그분이 그들에게 나타나셨다. 그리고 그들의 믿지 않음과 마음의 완고함을 꾸짖으셨다. 그분이 살아나신 뒤에 그분을 본 사람들의 말을 그들이 믿지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 열한 제자가 음식을 먹고 있을 때에 예수께서 그들에게 나타나셨다. 그리고 그들이 믿지 않고 마음이 굳어 있는 것을 꾸짖으셨다. 예수께서 살아나신 뒤에 예수를 본 사람들의 말을 그들이 믿지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 나중에 열한 제자가 함께 밥을 먹고 있을 때, 예수께서 그들에게 나타나셨다. 예수께서는 그들을 꾸짖으셨다. 그들이 믿지 않았고 마음이 고집스러웠기 때문이다. 그들은 다시 살아나신 예수를 본 사람들의 말을 믿지 않았다.

es.L: Más tarde se apareció a los once mismos, mientras estaban reclinados [a la mesa], y les reprochó su incredulidad y dureza de corazón, porque no habían creído a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} habían visto resucitado.
es.B: Más tarde se apareció a los once mientras comían. Les reprochó su incredulidad y su corazón endurecido, porque no habían creído a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} habían visto resucitado.
es.R: Después, Jesús se apareció a los once apóstoles mientras estaban comiendo. Los regañó porque no creían y eran tercos. No les habían creído a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} vieron vivo otra vez.

fr.L: Plus tard, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se manifesta aux onze eux-mêmes, alors qu’ils étaient étendus [à table], et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur reprocha leur incrédulité et leur dureté de cœur, parce qu’ils n’avaient pas cru ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient vu ressuscité.
fr.B: Plus tard, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se manifesta aux onze eux-mêmes pendant qu’ils mangeaient. Il leur reprocha leur incrédulité et leur cœur endurci, parce qu’ils n’avaient pas cru ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient vu ressuscité.
fr.R: Plus tard, Jésus est apparu aux onze apôtres pendant qu’ils prenaient un repas. Il leur a fait des reproches, parce qu’ils ne croyaient pas et que leur cœur était dur. En effet, ils n’avaient pas cru ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avaient vu vivant de nouveau.

sw.L: Na baadaye aliwatokea wale kumi na mmoja wenyewe walipokuwa wameketi [kula], akawakemea kwa kutokuamini kwao na ugumu wa mioyo yao, kwa sababu hawakuwaamini wale waliomwona baada ya kufufuliwa.
sw.B: Baadaye aliwatokea wale kumi na mmoja wenyewe walipokuwa wakila. Akawakemea kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao na ukaidi wa mioyo yao, kwa kuwa hawakuwaamini wale waliokuwa wamemwona amefufuliwa.
sw.R: Baadaye Yesu aliwatokea wale mitume kumi na mmoja walipokuwa wakila chakula. Aliwakaripia kwa sababu hawakuamini, na mioyo yao ilikuwa migumu. Hawakuwa wamewaamini watu waliomwona akiwa hai tena.

pt.L: E mais tarde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu aos próprios Onze, quando estavam reclinados [à mesa], e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} repreendeu a incredulidade e a dureza de coração deles, porque não tinham crido nos que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tinham visto depois que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi ressuscitado.
pt.B: Mais tarde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu aos Onze, enquanto eles comiam. Ele os repreendeu pela falta de fé e pela teimosia do coração deles, porque não tinham crido nos que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tinham visto ressuscitado.
pt.R: Depois Jesus apareceu aos onze apóstolos enquanto eles faziam uma refeição. Ele os repreendeu porque não acreditaram e porque o coração deles era teimoso. Eles não tinham acreditado nas pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} viram vivo de novo.

am.L: በኋላም [በማዕድ] ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ለአሥራ አንዱ ራሳቸው ተገለጠላቸው፤ ከተነሣም በኋላ ያዩትን ስላላመኑ አለማመናቸውንና የልባቸውን ድንዳኔ ነቀፈ።
am.B: በኋላም አሥራ አንዱ ራሳቸው በማዕድ ሳሉ ተገለጠላቸው። ከሞት ተነሥቶ ያዩትን ሰዎች ስላላመኑ ስለ አለማመናቸውና ስለ ልበ ደንዳናነታቸው ገሠጻቸው።
am.R: ከዚያ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ለአሥራ አንዱ ሐዋርያት ምግብ እየበሉ ሳሉ ተገለጠላቸው። ስላላመኑና ልባቸው ደንዳና ስለ ሆነ ገሠጻቸው። ሕያው ሆኖ ያዩትን ሰዎች አላመኑአቸውም ነበር።

decisions.choice: reclining: lying at table on couches, the custom at a meal
decisions.reason: At formal meals people lay on couches around a low table, leaning on one arm (14:18).

decisions.choice: the eleven: the twelve without Judas
decisions.reason: Judas had handed Jesus over (14:10, 14:43). The group is still called by its number.

decisions.choice: hardness of heart: a mind closed and unwilling
decisions.reason: The heart is the place of thought and will, as in 3:5, 6:52 and 8:17.

decisions.choice: the text of the SBLGNT, without the addition after 16:14
alternatives: add a long reply of the disciples and Jesus' answer after 16:14
decisions.reason: One fifth-century manuscript, Codex Washingtonianus, adds a passage after this verse in which the disciples excuse their unbelief and Jesus answers them. It is found nowhere else. Some manuscripts also add "from the dead" after "raised". Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: eating (B, R); stubborn hearts (B); their hearts were stubborn (R)
alternatives: reclining at table; hardness of heart
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what reclining at table means and use "stubborn" for the hard heart. Readable says "apostles" to name the eleven and "scolded" for rebuked.

decisions.choice: "mười một [môn đồ]" (L); "mười một môn đồ" (B); "mười một sứ đồ" (R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a noun after a number; the Greek says only "the eleven". Readable says "apostles" as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "sự vô tín" (L); "không tin" (B, R); "lòng cứng cỏi"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the nouns into the plain verb "tin" used through the book; "cứng cỏi" keeps the Greek picture of a hard heart.

decisions.choice: "열한 [제자]" (L); "열한 제자" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean cannot use the bare number as a noun here; as "열둘" / "열두 제자" in Mark 4:10, the book's word for disciples is kept rather than the English Readable's "apostles".

decisions.choice: "[식탁에] 기대어 앉다" (L), "음식을 먹다" (B), "밥을 먹다" (R); "마음의 완고함" (L), "마음이 굳어 있는 것" (B), "마음이 고집스러웠다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the posture at table with the place supplied; the hardness of heart takes the forms of Mark 3:5. "완악함" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: reclinados [a la mesa] (L); comían (B, R); dureza de corazón (L); corazón endurecido (B); eran tercos (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: people lay on couches at a meal (meaning decision m1), so Balanced and Readable say they were eating. Hardness of heart is a closed and unwilling mind (meaning decision m3); Balanced keeps the picture, Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: leur incrédulité (L, B); ils ne croyaient pas (R); dureté de cœur (L); cœur endurci (B); cœur dur (R)
decisions.reason: "Incrédulité" is the noun of "croire" in French, so the link with "ils n'avaient pas cru" stays visible; "manque de foi" would bring in the key term "foi", which the Greek does not use here. The heart keeps its picture at every level, as hardness of heart is the Gospel's image of a closed mind (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: ugumu wa mioyo (L); ukaidi wa mioyo (B); mioyo yao ilikuwa migumu (R)
decisions.reason: A mind closed and unwilling (meaning decision). Literal keeps the picture of a hard heart; Balanced says "ukaidi" (stubbornness), as the English "stubborn hearts".

decisions.choice: "[በማዕድ] ተቀምጠው" ("sitting [at table]") (L); "በማዕድ ሳሉ" ("while at table") (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "reclining", the posture at a meal; an Amharic reader would take "lying down" as resting, so the table is named, in brackets at Literal.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Πορευθέντες εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἅπαντα κηρύξατε τὸ εὐαγγέλιον πάσῃ τῇ κτίσει.

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, Having gone into the world all proclaim the gospel to all the creation.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Going into all the world, proclaim the gospel to the whole creation.
en.B: He told them, "Go out into the whole world and announce the gospel to all of creation.
en.R: Jesus told them, "Go everywhere in the world. Tell the good news to every person.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Hãy đi khắp thế gian, rao giảng Tin Lành cho mọi tạo vật.
vi.B: Ngài bảo họ: "Hãy đi khắp thế gian và rao giảng Tin Lành cho mọi tạo vật.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu bảo họ: "Hãy đi khắp nơi trên thế gian. Hãy rao báo Tin Lành cho mọi người.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "온 세상에 가서, 모든 피조물에게 복음을 선포하여라.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "온 세상에 나가서 모든 피조물에게 복음을 전하여라.
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "온 세상 곳곳에 가거라. 그리고 모든 사람에게 기쁜 소식을 전하여라.

es.L: Y les dijo: «Yendo por todo el mundo, {{plural_you:proclamen|proclamad}} el evangelio a toda la creación.
es.B: Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} por todo el mundo y {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} el evangelio a toda la creación.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a todas partes del mundo. {{plural_you:Anuncien|Anunciad}} la buena noticia a todas las personas.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Allant dans le monde entier, proclamez l’Évangile à toute la création.
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Allez dans le monde entier et annoncez l’Évangile à toute la création.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Allez partout dans le monde. Annoncez la bonne nouvelle à tous les êtres humains.

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Mkienda ulimwenguni kote, hubirini Injili kwa viumbe vyote.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Nendeni katika ulimwengu wote, mkatangaze Injili kwa viumbe vyote.
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Nendeni kila mahali ulimwenguni. Mwambieni kila mtu Habari Njema.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Indo por todo o mundo, proclamem o evangelho a toda a criação.
pt.B: Ele lhes disse: "Vão pelo mundo inteiro e anunciem o evangelho a toda a criação.
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Vão a todos os lugares do mundo. Contem as boas-novas a todas as pessoas.

am.L: እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ሄዳችሁ ለፍጥረት ሁሉ ወንጌልን ስበኩ።
am.B: እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ሂዱና ወንጌልን ለፍጥረት ሁሉ አውጁ።
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «በዓለም ሁሉ ሂዱ። የምሥራቹን ለሰው ሁሉ ንገሩ።

decisions.choice: the world: the whole inhabited earth, all its peoples
decisions.reason: Here the word means the earth and everyone in it, as in 14:9, where the gospel is to be proclaimed in all the world.

decisions.choice: all the creation: every human being
decisions.reason: The gospel is preached to people. The phrase means everyone, everywhere, as in Colossians 1:23.

decisions.choice: the command to proclaim: compare Matthew 28:19-20 and Mark 13:10
decisions.reason: Jesus said the gospel must first be proclaimed to all nations (13:10). Matthew 28:19 gives the command to make disciples of all nations.

decisions.choice: every person
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who is meant. Readable says "good news" for gospel, as elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "Tin Lành" at every level
decisions.reason: The Protestant word for the gospel, as in Colossians 1:5; it already means "good news", so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "good news".

decisions.choice: "복음" (L, B), "기쁜 소식" (R); "모든 피조물" (L, B), "모든 사람" (R)
decisions.reason: "복음" is the term of the Korean Colossians, and Readable's "기쁜 소식" is that of Mark 3:14; all creation here means every human being (meaning decision), which Readable says.

decisions.choice: el evangelio (L, B); la buena noticia (R); a toda la creación (L, B); a todas las personas (R)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in the Spanish: "evangelio" at Literal and Balanced, "buena noticia" at Readable. "Toda la creación" here means every human being (meaning decision m2), which Readable says. The commands are plural, with the ustedes / vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: l'Évangile (L, B); la bonne nouvelle (R)
alternatives: la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: The key term as French renders it elsewhere (Galatians, 1 Peter): "l'Évangile" at Literal and Balanced, the plain "la bonne nouvelle" at Readable. "Tous les êtres humains" is already inclusive, so it needs no gender span.

decisions.choice: Injili (L, B); Habari Njema (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili letters: the noun gospel is "Injili" at Literal and Balanced and "Habari Njema", capitalised, at Readable, as the English Readable says "good news". "Viumbe vyote" (all creatures) keeps the Greek "all the creation"; it means every human being (meaning decision), which Readable says.

source.text: ὁ πιστεύσας καὶ βαπτισθεὶς σωθήσεται, ὁ δὲ ἀπιστήσας κατακριθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] having believed and having been baptized will be saved, the [one] however having disbelieved will be condemned.

en.L: The one who has believed and has been baptized will be saved, but the one who has disbelieved will be condemned.
en.B: Whoever has believed and been baptized will be saved; anyone who refuses to believe will be condemned.
en.R: Those who believe and are baptized will be saved. But those who do not believe will be judged guilty.

vi.L: Người đã tin và đã chịu báp-têm sẽ được cứu, còn người đã không tin sẽ bị kết án.
vi.B: Ai tin và chịu báp-têm sẽ được cứu; còn ai không chịu tin sẽ bị kết án.
vi.R: Những ai tin và chịu báp-têm sẽ được cứu. Nhưng những ai không tin sẽ bị kết án.

ko.L: 믿고 세례를 받은 사람은 구원을 받을 것이다. 그러나 믿지 않은 사람은 정죄를 받을 것이다.
ko.B: 믿고 세례를 받는 사람은 구원을 받을 것이고, 믿기를 거부하는 사람은 정죄를 받을 것이다.
ko.R: 믿고 세례를 받는 사람은 구원을 받을 것이다. 그러나 믿지 않는 사람은 죄가 있다는 판결을 받을 것이다.

es.L: El que haya creído y haya sido bautizado será salvo; pero el que no haya creído será condenado.
es.B: El que crea y sea bautizado será salvo; pero el que se niegue a creer será condenado.
es.R: Los que crean y se bauticen serán salvados. Pero los que no crean serán declarados culpables.

fr.L: Celui qui aura cru et aura été baptisé sera sauvé, mais celui qui n’aura pas cru sera condamné.
fr.B: Celui qui aura cru et aura été baptisé sera sauvé ; celui qui aura refusé de croire sera condamné.
fr.R: Ceux qui croient et qui sont baptisés seront sauvés. Mais ceux qui ne croient pas seront déclarés coupables.

sw.L: Yule aliyeamini na kubatizwa ataokolewa, lakini yule ambaye hakuamini atahukumiwa.
sw.B: Kila aliyeamini na kubatizwa ataokolewa; yeyote anayekataa kuamini atahukumiwa.
sw.R: Watu wanaoamini na kubatizwa wataokolewa. Lakini wale wasioamini watahukumiwa kuwa na hatia.

pt.L: Aquele que tiver crido e tiver sido batizado será salvo, mas aquele que não tiver crido será condenado.
pt.B: Quem crer e for batizado será salvo; quem se recusar a crer será condenado.
pt.R: As pessoas que acreditarem e forem batizadas serão salvas. Mas as que não acreditarem serão julgadas culpadas.

am.L: ያመነና የተጠመቀ ይድናል፤ ያላመነ ግን ይፈረድበታል።
am.B: ያመነና የተጠመቀ ሁሉ ይድናል፤ ለማመን እምቢ ያለ ግን ይፈረድበታል።
am.R: የሚያምኑና የሚጠመቁ ይድናሉ። የማያምኑ ግን ጥፋተኞች ተብለው ይፈረድባቸዋል።

decisions.choice: believed and baptized: faith and baptism belong together; the negative names unbelief alone
alternatives: baptism is required for salvation in every case
decisions.reason: The second half does not say "not baptized". It is unbelief that brings condemnation.

decisions.choice: will be saved: rescued from judgment, at the last day
decisions.reason: The word is used of salvation at the end in 13:13 and of rescue in this life in 5:34. Set against condemnation, it means final rescue.

decisions.choice: condemned: judged guilty and sentenced
decisions.reason: The word means the verdict of a judge (10:33; 14:64).

decisions.choice: refuses to believe (B); do not believe (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the verb believe with a negative. Readable says "judged guilty" for condemned and uses the plural "those who" for the general saying.

decisions.choice: "chịu báp-têm" for being baptized
decisions.reason: The Protestant phrase for receiving baptism (Romans 6), matching "làm báp-têm" for the act.

decisions.choice: "정죄를 받다" (L, B); "죄가 있다는 판결을 받다" (R)
decisions.reason: "정죄" is the word of the Korean John (3:17-18; 8:10-11); Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: se niegue a creer (B); serán declarados culpables (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: the verb is the refusal to believe, and condemned means judged guilty (meaning decision m3). "El que" and "los que" are general, so no gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: aura cru ... sera sauvé (future perfect and future, L, B)
alternatives: Celui qui croit et est baptisé (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek past participles look from the coming judgment back to a life (meaning decision m2); the French future perfect says that naturally. Readable uses the present, as the English Readable does.

source.text: σημεῖα δὲ τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ταῦτα παρακολουθήσει, ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δαιμόνια ἐκβαλοῦσιν, γλώσσαις λαλήσουσιν καιναῖς, ὄφεις ἀροῦσιν κἂν θανάσιμόν τι πίωσιν οὐ μὴ αὐτοὺς βλάψῃ, ἐπὶ ἀρρώστους χεῖρας ἐπιθήσουσιν καὶ καλῶς ἕξουσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Signs now those having believed these will accompany: in the name of me demons they will cast out, with tongues they will speak new, \v 18 serpents they will take up, and if deadly anything they drink, no not them shall it hurt, upon [the] sick hands they will lay, and well they will be.

en.L: And these signs will accompany those who have believed: in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new tongues; \v 18 they will pick up serpents, and if they drink anything deadly, it will not hurt them at all; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will be well."
en.B: These signs will go with those who believe: they will throw out demons in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name and speak in new tongues; \v 18 they will lift up snakes; if they swallow any deadly poison, it will do them no harm; they will put their hands on those who are sick, and the sick will get better."
en.R: And these signs will be seen with those who believe. They will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name to force demons to leave people. They will speak in new languages. \v 18 They will pick up snakes. If they drink some poison that kills, it will not hurt them. They will put their hands on sick people, and the sick people will get well."

vi.L: Và những dấu lạ này sẽ đi theo những người đã tin: trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} họ sẽ đuổi quỷ; họ sẽ nói những tiếng mới; \v 18 họ sẽ cầm rắn lên, và nếu họ uống phải thứ gì độc chết người, thì cũng chẳng hại gì cho họ; họ sẽ đặt tay trên người bệnh, và người bệnh sẽ được lành."
vi.B: Những dấu lạ này sẽ đi kèm những người tin: nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} họ sẽ đuổi quỷ và nói những tiếng mới; \v 18 họ sẽ cầm rắn lên; nếu họ uống phải chất độc chết người, chất độc ấy cũng không làm hại họ; họ sẽ đặt tay trên người bệnh, và người bệnh sẽ được khỏe lại."
vi.R: Những dấu lạ này sẽ đi theo những người tin. Họ sẽ nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà đuổi quỷ ra khỏi người ta. Họ sẽ nói những ngôn ngữ mới. \v 18 Họ sẽ cầm rắn lên. Nếu họ uống phải chất độc chết người, họ cũng không bị hại gì. Họ sẽ đặt tay trên người bệnh, và người bệnh sẽ được lành."

ko.L: 그리고 믿은 사람들에게는 이런 표적들이 따를 것이다. 그들은 내 이름으로 귀신들을 쫓아내고, 새 방언으로 말하고, \v 18 뱀들을 집어 들고, 죽게 하는 무엇을 마셔도 결코 해를 입지 않고, 아픈 사람들에게 손을 얹으면 그들이 나을 것이다."
ko.B: 믿는 사람들에게는 이런 표적들이 따를 것이다. 그들은 내 이름으로 귀신을 쫓아내고, 새 방언으로 말할 것이다. \v 18 뱀을 집어 들 것이고, 무슨 독을 마셔도 전혀 해를 입지 않을 것이다. 그들이 아픈 사람들에게 손을 얹으면 아픈 사람들이 나을 것이다."
ko.R: 그리고 믿는 사람들에게는 이런 표적들이 함께 나타날 것이다. 표적은 하나님께서 일하고 계심을 보여 주는 일이다. 그들은 내 이름의 힘으로 귀신을 사람들에게서 쫓아낼 것이다. 그들은 배우지 않은 새로운 언어로 말할 것이다. \v 18 그들은 뱀을 집어 들 것이다. 사람을 죽이는 독을 마셔도 해를 입지 않을 것이다. 그들이 아픈 사람들에게 손을 얹으면 아픈 사람들이 나을 것이다."

es.L: Y estas señales acompañarán a los que hayan creído: en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre echarán demonios; hablarán en lenguas nuevas; \v 18 levantarán serpientes [con las manos], y si beben algo mortal, no les hará ningún daño; impondrán las manos sobre los enfermos, y estos sanarán».
es.B: Estas señales acompañarán a los que crean: en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre expulsarán demonios y hablarán en lenguas nuevas; \v 18 levantarán serpientes con las manos, y si beben algún veneno mortal, no les hará ningún daño; pondrán las manos sobre los enfermos, y estos se sanarán».
es.R: Y estas señales se verán en los que crean. Usarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para obligar a los demonios a salir de la gente. Hablarán en idiomas nuevos. \v 18 Tomarán serpientes con las manos. Si beben algún veneno mortal, no les hará daño. Pondrán las manos sobre los enfermos, y los enfermos se pondrán bien».

fr.L: Or voici les signes qui accompagneront ceux qui auront cru : en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom ils chasseront des démons ; ils parleront de nouvelles langues ; \v 18 ils prendront des serpents, et s’ils boivent quelque chose de mortel, cela ne leur fera aucun mal ; ils imposeront les mains aux malades, et ceux-ci se porteront bien. »
fr.B: Voici les signes qui accompagneront ceux qui croient : en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, ils chasseront des démons et parleront de nouvelles langues ; \v 18 ils prendront des serpents dans leurs mains ; s’ils boivent un poison mortel, il ne leur fera aucun mal ; ils poseront les mains sur les malades, et les malades guériront. »
fr.R: Et voici les signes que l’on verra chez ceux qui croient. Ils utiliseront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour obliger des démons à sortir des gens. Ils parleront de nouvelles langues. \v 18 Ils prendront des serpents dans leurs mains. S’ils boivent un poison qui tue, cela ne leur fera pas de mal. Ils poseront les mains sur des malades, et les malades guériront. »

sw.L: Na ishara hizi zitaandamana na wale walioamini: kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} watafukuza pepo; watanena kwa ndimi mpya; \v 18 watawainua nyoka, na hata wakinywa kitu chochote kinachoua, hakitawaumiza hata kidogo; wataweka mikono juu ya wagonjwa, nao watakuwa wazima."
sw.B: Ishara hizi zitaambatana na wale wanaoamini: kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} watawafukuza pepo na kunena kwa ndimi mpya; \v 18 watawainua nyoka; wakimeza sumu yoyote ya kuua, haitawadhuru; wataweka mikono yao juu ya wagonjwa, na wagonjwa hao watapata nafuu."
sw.R: Ishara hizi zitaonekana pamoja na wale wanaoamini. Watatumia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kuwafukuza pepo watoke ndani ya watu. Watazungumza lugha mpya. \v 18 Watawashika nyoka. Wakinywa sumu inayoua, haitawadhuru. Wataweka mikono yao juu ya wagonjwa, na wagonjwa hao watapona."

pt.L: E estes sinais acompanharão os que tiverem crido: em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome expulsarão demônios; falarão em novas línguas; \v 18 pegarão serpentes, e, se beberem alguma coisa mortal, de modo nenhum lhes fará mal; imporão as mãos sobre os enfermos, e [estes] ficarão bem."
pt.B: Estes sinais acompanharão os que crerem: em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome expulsarão demônios e falarão em novas línguas; \v 18 pegarão cobras; se tomarem algum veneno mortal, não sofrerão mal nenhum; porão as mãos sobre os doentes, e os doentes ficarão curados."
pt.R: E estes sinais vão ser vistos com as pessoas que acreditarem. Elas vão usar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome para obrigar demônios a sair das pessoas. Vão falar em línguas novas. \v 18 Vão pegar cobras. Se beberem algum veneno que mata, não vão sofrer nenhum mal. Vão pôr as mãos sobre pessoas doentes, e essas pessoas vão ficar boas."

am.L: ያመኑትንም እነዚህ ምልክቶች ይከተሏቸዋል፤ በስሜ አጋንንትን ያወጣሉ፤ በአዲስ ልሳኖች ይናገራሉ፤ \v 18 እባቦችን ያነሣሉ፤ የሚገድልም ነገር ቢጠጡ ፈጽሞ አይጎዳቸውም፤ እጃቸውን በድውያን ላይ ይጭናሉ፤ እነርሱም ይድናሉ።»
am.B: ለሚያምኑትም እነዚህ ምልክቶች አብረዋቸው ይሆናሉ፤ በስሜ አጋንንትን ያወጣሉ፤ በአዲስ ልሳንም ይናገራሉ፤ \v 18 እባቦችን በእጃቸው ያነሣሉ፤ የሚገድል መርዝ ቢጠጡ ምንም አይጎዳቸውም፤ እጃቸውን በታመሙ ሰዎች ላይ ይጭናሉ፤ ሕመምተኞቹም ይሻላቸዋል።»
am.R: የሚያምኑ ሰዎችም እነዚህን ምልክቶች ያሳያሉ። ስሜን ተጠቅመው አጋንንት ከሰዎች እንዲወጡ ያስገድዳሉ። በአዲስ ቋንቋዎች ይናገራሉ። \v 18 እባቦችን ያነሣሉ። የሚገድል መርዝ ቢጠጡ አይጎዳቸውም። እጃቸውን በታመሙ ሰዎች ላይ ይጭናሉ፤ የታመሙትም ይፈወሳሉ።»

decisions.choice: signs: acts of power that point to God at work
decisions.reason: In 8:11-12 Jesus refused to give a sign to those who demanded one. Here signs follow the preaching and confirm it (16:20).

decisions.choice: the signs: each is told of the apostles in Acts
decisions.reason: Demons are cast out (Acts 16:18), believers speak in tongues (Acts 2:4; 10:46), Paul is bitten by a snake and not harmed (Acts 28:3-6), and the sick are healed by the laying on of hands (Acts 28:8). There is no story of drinking poison in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: new tongues: speech given by the Spirit, in languages not learned
decisions.reason: In Acts 2:4-11 the disciples speak in other languages. Paul speaks of tongues as speech in the Spirit (1 Corinthians 14:2). The verse does not say which is meant.

decisions.choice: if they drink anything deadly: a promise of protection, not a command to test God
decisions.reason: The sentence is a condition: if it happens, they will not be harmed. Jesus refused to test God by putting himself in danger (Matthew 4:5-7).

decisions.choice: they will pick up serpents, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: and with their hands they will pick up serpents
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts add "and with their hands". Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: languages
decisions.reason: Readable uses "languages" for the word that also means the tongue in the mouth. Readable also uses "force demons to leave people", as in earlier chapters.

decisions.choice: "dấu lạ" for signs
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for sign, as in John (2:11): it points to God at work rather than simply naming a wonder.

decisions.choice: "tiếng" (L, B); "ngôn ngữ" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word for a language; "tiếng lạ" would add "strange", which the Greek "new" does not say.

decisions.choice: "표적" at every level; Readable explains it once
decisions.reason: The key term of the Korean John (style guide, section 6), never "기적"; Readable says what a sign is, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "새 방언" (L, B); "배우지 않은 새로운 언어" (R)
decisions.reason: "방언" is the established Korean word for speech given by the Spirit; Readable says what it is, as the meaning decision and the English Readable do.

decisions.choice: idiomas (R); lenguas (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says "idiomas", languages not learned (meaning decision m3). The possessive "mi" for Christ takes the deity_pronoun setting, by the rule set for Mark at 1:2.

decisions.choice: de nouvelles langues (every level)
decisions.reason: French "langue" means both the tongue and a language, so every level can keep the one word (meaning decision m3), where the English Readable has to change "tongues" to "languages".

decisions.choice: kunena kwa ndimi mpya (L, B); kuzungumza lugha mpya (R)
decisions.reason: "Kunena kwa ndimi" (to speak in tongues) is the term Swahili churches use for speech given by the Spirit (meaning decision), and "ndimi" keeps the Greek word "tongues". Readable says "lugha" (languages), as the English Readable does. "Ishara" (sign) is the key term of Swahili John.

decisions.choice: línguas
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "languages" for the word that also means the tongue in the mouth. Portuguese "língua" already means both, so Readable keeps it and the openness that m3 describes; "idiomas" would settle the question.

decisions.choice: "ልሳን" (tongue, the church word for speaking in tongues) (L, B); "ቋንቋ" (language) (R)
decisions.reason: "ልሳን" is the word Amharic Christians use for speaking in tongues; Readable uses the everyday word for a language, as the English Readable says "languages".

source.text: Ὁ μὲν οὖν κύριος Ἰησοῦς μετὰ τὸ λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς ἀνελήμφθη εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The indeed therefore Lord Jesus after the speaking to them was taken up into the heaven and sat at [the] right hand of God.

en.L: So then the Lord Jesus, after speaking to them, was taken up into heaven and sat down at [the] right hand of God.
en.B: So the Lord Jesus, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven and took {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} seat at the right hand of God.
en.R: After the Lord Jesus finished talking to them, God took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up into heaven. There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sat down at God's right side, the place of highest honor.

vi.L: Vậy, Chúa Giê-xu, sau khi nói với họ, được cất lên trời và ngồi bên phải Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Vậy, sau khi nói với họ, Chúa Giê-xu được cất lên trời và ngồi bên phải Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Khi Chúa Giê-xu nói với họ xong, Đức Chúa Trời đem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên trời. Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngồi bên phải Đức Chúa Trời, là chỗ tôn quý nhất.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 예수께서는 그들에게 말씀하신 뒤에 하늘로 들려 올라가셔서 하나님의 오른편에 앉으셨다.
ko.B: 주 예수께서는 그들에게 말씀하신 뒤에 하늘로 들려 올라가셔서 하나님의 오른편에 앉으셨다.
ko.R: 주 예수께서 그들에게 말씀을 마치시자, 하나님께서 예수를 하늘로 데려가셨다. 예수께서는 거기서 하나님의 오른편, 가장 높은 영광의 자리에 앉으셨다.

es.L: Así pues, el Señor Jesús, después de hablarles, fue llevado arriba al cielo y se sentó a [la] diestra de Dios.
es.B: Así que el Señor Jesús, después de hablarles, fue llevado al cielo y se sentó a la derecha de Dios.
es.R: Cuando el Señor Jesús terminó de hablarles, Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevó al cielo. Allí se sentó a la derecha de Dios, el lugar de más alto honor.

fr.L: Ainsi donc le Seigneur Jésus, après leur avoir parlé, fut enlevé au ciel et s’assit à la droite de Dieu.
fr.B: Ainsi, après leur avoir parlé, le Seigneur Jésus fut enlevé au ciel et prit place à la droite de Dieu.
fr.R: Quand le Seigneur Jésus a eu fini de leur parler, Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a enlevé au ciel. Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est assis à la droite de Dieu, à la place d’honneur.

sw.L: Basi Bwana Yesu, baada ya kuongea nao, alipandishwa mbinguni, akaketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo Bwana Yesu, alipokwisha kuzungumza nao, alipandishwa juu mbinguni, akaketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
sw.R: Bwana Yesu alipomaliza kuzungumza nao, Mungu alimchukua juu mbinguni. Huko aliketi upande wa kulia wa Mungu, mahali pa heshima kuu.

pt.L: Assim, pois, o Senhor Jesus, depois de lhes falar, foi elevado ao céu e se sentou à direita de Deus.
pt.B: Então o Senhor Jesus, depois que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes falou, foi levado ao céu e tomou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar à direita de Deus.
pt.R: Depois que o Senhor Jesus terminou de falar com eles, Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} levou para o céu. Lá {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se sentou do lado direito de Deus, o lugar de maior honra.

am.L: እንግዲህ ጌታ ኢየሱስ ከተናገራቸው በኋላ ወደ ሰማይ ተወሰደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቀኝ ተቀመጠ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ጌታ ኢየሱስ ከተናገራቸው በኋላ ወደ ሰማይ ተወሰደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቀኝ ተቀመጠ።
am.R: ጌታ ኢየሱስ ከእነርሱ ጋር ተነጋግሮ ከጨረሰ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ሰማይ ወሰደው። በዚያም ከፍተኛ የክብር ስፍራ በሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ተቀመጠ።

decisions.choice: sat at the right hand of God: the words of Psalm 110:1
alternatives: only a picture of being near God
decisions.reason: Jesus quoted Psalm 110:1 in 12:36 and used its words before the high priest in 14:62. To sit at a king's right hand is to share his rule and honor.

decisions.choice: was taken up: a passive, God took him up
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of Elijah (2 Kings 2:11) and of Jesus in Acts 1:2, 1:11.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus: Jesus named as Lord
alternatives: Lord as a polite title, sir
decisions.reason: Mark's own narrative does not call Jesus "the Lord Jesus". The full title belongs to the early church's preaching (Acts 1:21).

decisions.choice: God took him up; the place of highest honor
alternatives: was taken up; at the right hand
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who took him up, as the passive implies, and explains what the right hand means.

decisions.choice: "Chúa Giê-xu" for "the Lord Jesus", without "Đức"
decisions.reason: "Chúa" is itself the title of honour, so "Đức" is not added before the name, as in Colossians 3:17.

decisions.choice: "들려 올라가다" (L, B) for the passive "was taken up"; "오른편" at every level
decisions.reason: "들려 올라가다" keeps the passive (God took him up); "오른편" is the dignified word of the Korean Colossians 3:1 for the place of honour.

decisions.choice: a [la] diestra de Dios (L); a la derecha de Dios (B, R); el lugar de más alto honor (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Psalm 110:1 (meaning decision m1). Literal uses "diestra", as Colossians 3:1 Spanish; Balanced and Readable say "derecha", and Readable says what the place meant, as Hebrews 1:3 Spanish does. Readable names God as the one who took him up (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: alipandishwa (L, B); Mungu alimchukua (R); mkono wa kuume (L, B), upande wa kulia (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is passive: God took him up (meaning decision). "Kupandishwa" (to be taken up) keeps the passive, where "kupaa" (to ascend) would make Jesus the actor; Readable names God, as the English does. "Mkono wa kuume wa Mungu" is the phrase of Psalm 110:1 as the Swahili letters render it (Hebrews, 1 Peter 3:22); Readable says "upande wa kulia" and explains it.

decisions.choice: "ወደ ሰማይ ተወሰደ" ("was taken up into heaven") (L, B); "እግዚአብሔር ወደ ሰማይ ወሰደው" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek is passive, God took him up (meaning decision m2); "ዐረገ" is the familiar church word for the ascension but makes Jesus the one who acts, so the passive is kept.

source.text: ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἐκήρυξαν πανταχοῦ, τοῦ κυρίου συνεργοῦντος καὶ τὸν λόγον βεβαιοῦντος διὰ τῶν ἐπακολουθούντων σημείων.

records.literal_gloss: They now having gone out proclaimed everywhere, the Lord working with [them] and the word confirming by the accompanying signs.

en.L: And they went out and proclaimed everywhere, while the Lord worked with [them] and confirmed the word through the signs that accompanied [it].]
en.B: And they went out and proclaimed the message everywhere. The Lord worked with them and confirmed the word by the signs that came with it.]
en.R: Then the followers went out and told the message everywhere. The Lord worked with them. He proved that their message was true by the signs that happened along with it.]

vi.L: Còn những người ấy ra đi rao giảng khắp nơi, trong khi Chúa cùng làm việc với [họ] và xác nhận lời ấy qua các dấu lạ đi kèm.]
vi.B: Họ ra đi và rao giảng sứ điệp khắp nơi. Chúa cùng làm việc với họ và xác nhận lời ấy bằng những dấu lạ đi kèm.]
vi.R: Rồi các môn đồ ra đi và rao báo sứ điệp ấy khắp nơi. Chúa cùng làm việc với họ. Ngài chứng tỏ sứ điệp của họ là thật bằng những dấu lạ xảy ra kèm theo.]

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 나가서 곳곳에서 선포했다. 주님께서 [그들과] 함께 일하시며, [말씀에] 따르는 표적들을 통하여 말씀을 확증하셨다.]
ko.B: 제자들은 나가서 곳곳에서 말씀을 전했다. 주님께서 그들과 함께 일하시고, 말씀에 따르는 표적들로 그 말씀이 참되다는 것을 확증해 주셨다.]
ko.R: 그 뒤에 제자들은 나가서 모든 곳에 다니며 기쁜 소식을 전했다. 주님께서 그들과 함께 일하셨다. 그리고 표적들을 일으키셔서 그들이 전하는 말씀이 참되다는 것을 보여 주셨다.]

es.L: Y ellos salieron y proclamaron por todas partes, mientras el Señor obraba con [ellos] y confirmaba la palabra por medio de las señales que [la] acompañaban.]
es.B: Y ellos salieron y anunciaron el mensaje por todas partes. El Señor actuaba con ellos y confirmaba la palabra con las señales que la acompañaban.]
es.R: Entonces los discípulos salieron y anunciaron el mensaje por todas partes. El Señor trabajaba con ellos. Mostraba que el mensaje era verdadero por medio de las señales que lo acompañaban.]

fr.L: Et eux, étant partis, proclamèrent partout, le Seigneur agissant avec [eux] et confirmant la parole par les signes qui [l’]accompagnaient.]
fr.B: Et eux partirent proclamer le message partout. Le Seigneur agissait avec eux et confirmait la parole par les signes qui l’accompagnaient.]
fr.R: Alors les disciples sont partis et ils ont annoncé le message partout. Le Seigneur travaillait avec eux. Il montrait que leur message était vrai par les signes qui l’accompagnaient.]

sw.L: Hao nao walitoka, wakahubiri kila mahali, huku Bwana akishirikiana nao katika kazi na kulithibitisha neno kupitia ishara zilizoandamana [nalo].]
sw.B: Hao walitoka, wakahubiri ujumbe kila mahali. Bwana alishirikiana nao katika kazi, akalithibitisha neno kwa ishara zilizoambatana nalo.]
sw.R: Kisha wafuasi walitoka, wakawaambia watu ujumbe kila mahali. Bwana alifanya kazi pamoja nao. Alionyesha kwamba ujumbe wao ni wa kweli kwa ishara zilizotokea pamoja na ujumbe huo.]

pt.L: E eles, saindo, proclamaram por toda parte, enquanto o Senhor cooperava [com eles] e confirmava a palavra por meio dos sinais que [a] acompanhavam.]
pt.B: E eles saíram e anunciaram a mensagem por toda parte. O Senhor agia com eles e confirmava a palavra pelos sinais que a acompanhavam.]
pt.R: Então os seguidores saíram e anunciaram a mensagem em todo lugar. O Senhor trabalhava com eles. Ele mostrava que a mensagem deles era verdadeira por meio dos sinais que aconteciam junto com ela.]

am.L: እነርሱም ወጥተው በየስፍራው ሰበኩ፤ ጌታም አብሯቸው ይሠራ ነበር፤ ቃሉንም በሚከተሉት ምልክቶች ያጸና ነበር።]
am.B: እነርሱም ወጥተው መልእክቱን በየቦታው ሰበኩ። ጌታም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሠራ ነበር፤ ቃሉንም አብረውት በሚሆኑት ምልክቶች ያጸና ነበር።]
am.R: ከዚያም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወጥተው መልእክቱን በየቦታው ተናገሩ። ጌታም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሠራ ነበር። ከመልእክቱ ጋር አብረው በሚሆኑት ምልክቶችም መልእክታቸው እውነት መሆኑን አሳየ።]

decisions.choice: the word: the message of the gospel
decisions.reason: As in 2:2 and 4:14, "the word" means the message that is preached.

decisions.choice: confirming: showing to be true and reliable
decisions.reason: The verb was used of guarantees in law and business. The signs back up the message (Hebrews 2:3-4).

decisions.choice: the Lord worked with them: the risen Lord at work in their preaching
alternatives: they worked for the Lord, apart from him
decisions.reason: Though taken up into heaven, the Lord still acts with them.

decisions.choice: signs, the end of the SBLGNT text
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "Amen" at the end of the Gospel. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the message (B, R); the followers (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what they proclaimed. Readable names who went out and says "proved that their message was true" for confirmed.

decisions.choice: "주님" for the risen Lord; "말씀" for the message
decisions.reason: "주님" is how the Korean John names the risen Jesus (20:18); "말씀" is the book's word for God's message (Mark 4:14).

decisions.choice: el mensaje (B, R); los discípulos (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced and Readable say what they proclaimed, and Readable says who went out. "Confirmaba" (L, B) means showed to be true (meaning decision m2), which Readable says.

decisions.choice: a closing square bracket at the end of 16:20
decisions.reason: Closes the longer ending opened at 16:9 (see the notes there).
